title: trust.get result

anyOf.description: A repository identity: the one form every spelling of a repository's remote comes down to, https:// then the host without its port and the path of two segments or more, in lower case (repositoryIdentityOf and cases/repository-identity.json). An identity, not a link.
An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

A trust key: the repository identity a decision applies to, or the absolute path of a main checkout or a workspace for a repository with none. A key whose host later becomes a verified forge alias is read on the forge account's canonical host.

key.description: The session's trust key; null for a scratch workspace, which is never asked about.

anyOf.description: What a trust key is: identity (the session's repository identity), checkout (its repository's main checkout, with no identity) or directory (its workspace path, in no repository).

keyKind.description: What the key is; null with no key.

decision.description: The key's standing; undecided with no key.

instructionFiles.description: The instruction files, from the repository's root: CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md in the workspace directory and each parent up to the root, then each Markdown file under .claude/rules.

directory.description: The directory holding the root, from the repository's root: the workspace directory or one of its parents, . for the root.

items.description: A .claude/skills or .agents/skills in the workspace directory or a parent up to the repository's root, and the skills in it.

skillRoots.description: Each skill root holding a skill, nearest directory first, .claude/skills before .agents/skills.

event.description: The hook event, as the settings name it: PreToolUse, SessionStart.

hooks.description: The hook commands declared for it, across its matchers.

items.description: The hooks the repository's shared settings declare for one event.

hooks.description: The hooks .claude/settings.json declares, by event, in the order it names them.

allow.description: The rules in the settings' permissions.allow.

ask.description: The rules in the settings' permissions.ask.

deny.description: The rules in the settings' permissions.deny.

permissionRules.description: The permission rules .claude/settings.json declares, by list.

name.description: Its name among the mcpServers of the repository's .mcp.json.

loaded.description: Never loaded: a run's tool servers are the environment's alone (strictMcpConfig).

items.description: One of the MCP servers the repository's .mcp.json declares, marked not loaded: trust never admits it.

mcpServers.description: The servers .mcp.json declares, in its order, each marked not loaded.

anyOf.description: What trusting a repository would load, counted: instruction files, members per skill root, commands, hooks by event, permission rules and subagents; its MCP servers are listed and marked not loaded. Read from the repository's root, and for a worktree its settings, commands, subagents, rules and MCP servers from the main checkout, where the provider takes them.

offer.description: What trusting the repository would load, counted; null with no key.

description: A session's trust key and its kind, the decision recorded for it, and what its repository offers.
